acip: ZHAL LUNG LAS KYANG, ,'DI YI DON LDAN 'GA' ZHIG LA, ,NGA NI DE YI LUS GNAS TE, ,SGRUB PO GZHAN LA MCHOD PA LEN, ,DE YIS DE MNYES RANG GI RGYUD, ,LAS KYI SGRIB PA DAG BYED DO,
wylie: zhal lung las kyang, ,'di yi don ldan 'ga' zhig la, ,nga ni de yi lus gnas te, ,sgrub po gzhan la mchod pa len, ,de yis de mnyes rang gi rgyud, ,las kyi sgrib pa dag byed do
english: The Word from the Lips says as well, I live my life inside the bodies Of those few who hold this meaning; With other practitioners, The offering is only accepted-- But with this one, we are pleased, And then the karmic obstacles In this practitioner's being Are completely cleaned away.
